# Vendored front-end libraries

Served by `cashflow serve` so the pivot UI works offline and loads nothing from third parties.
All are MIT licensed; each licence is alongside.

| File | Package | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `pivot.min.js`, `pivot.min.css` | pivottable 2.23.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pivottable@2.23.0/dist/ |
| `subtotal.min.js`, `subtotal.min.css` | subtotal 1.11.0-alpha.0 (npm `latest`) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/subtotal@1.11.0-alpha.0/dist/ |
| `jquery.min.js` | jquery 3.7.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.7.1/dist/ |
| `jquery-ui.min.js` | jquery-ui 1.13.2 (drag and drop for pivottable) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery-ui@1.13.2/dist/ |

To upgrade, replace the files from the new version's `dist/` and update this table.
